justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Short-term trigger point pain reduction consistent; superiority over other manual techniques not established.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 1-2 day introductory course; ~$400-600; multiple providers; accessible; advanced courses optional.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to musculoskeletal and chronic pain caseloads; very useful in outpatient ortho and sports settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed as therapeutic procedure; covered by some commercial payers; growing acceptance; some states restrict PT dry needling scope.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Among the most employer-demanded PT certifications in outpatient ortho; listed in ~30% of outpatient PT postings in permitted states.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patient response variable; immediate relief creates strong positive impression when it occurs.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Strong cash-pay add-on; patients routinely pay out-of-pocket per session.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Still illegal/restricted in some states which raises scarcity, but broadly common among ortho/sports PTs.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Trainable for staff PTs so the practice (not just owner) can deliver it.
justifications.business.marketDemand: High consumer awareness, often searched directly.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Commercial CE credential with no academic standing for promotion/tenure.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Growing but mixed-quality literature; some faculty publish on it.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: State scope restrictions limit curricular integration; usually elective content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence is mixed; modest short-term effects, heterogeneous trials, contested vs sham.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Almost never listed in faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Short course time but limited academic payoff.
